blocks.zh: 第五章（上）：一般安全與性能要求 — GSPR 指引表
blocks.en: Chapter 5 (Part 1): General Safety and Performance Requirements - GSPR Guidance Table

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 MDR Annex I 中 General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPRs) 對預充填注射器系統的適用範圍
blocks.en: Understand the applicability of the General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPRs) in MDR Annex I to prefilled syringe systems

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 5.1-1🔍 的三欄結構：Device Part（裝置零件）、Syringe Subassembly（注射器次組件）、Plunger Stoppers（柱塞膠塞）各自的文件責任歸屬
blocks.en: Grasp the three-column structure of Table 5.1-1🔍: the documentation responsibilities for the Device Part, the Syringe Subassembly and the Plunger Stoppers

blocks.zh: 瞭解 Chapter I（一般要求，GSPR 1–8）與 Chapter II（設計與製造要求，GSPR 10–11）各項條款所需的支持性文件
blocks.en: Become familiar with the supportive documents needed for each requirement in Chapter I (General Requirements, GSPR 1-8) and Chapter II (Requirements regarding Design and Manufacture, GSPR 10-11)

blocks.zh: 學習申請者（Applicant）與供應商（Supplier）在法規符合性文件上的分工關係
blocks.en: Learn how responsibilities for regulatory compliance documentation are divided between the Applicant and the Supplier

blocks.zh: 5.0–5.1 Introduction to the GSPR Guidance Table 5.0–5.1 GSPR 指引表導論
blocks.en: 5.0-5.1 Introduction to the GSPR Guidance Table

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: GSPR (General Safety and Performance Requirements，一般安全與性能要求)：這是 EU MDR (Regulation (EU) 2017/745) Annex I 所列出的基本要求。醫療器材必須符合所有適用的 GSPR 才能取得 CE 標誌。
blocks.en: GSPR (General Safety and Performance Requirements): The basic requirements listed in Annex I of the EU MDR (Regulation (EU) 2017/745). A medical device must meet all applicable GSPRs to obtain the CE mark.

blocks.zh: Device Part (裝置零件)：指預充填注射器作為整體裝置的所有組成部分，包含針頭護套（soft needle shield）、帶潤滑的針頭、玻璃或聚合物筒身、柱塞膠塞等。
blocks.en: Device Part: All components of the prefilled syringe as a whole device, including the needle shield (soft needle shield), the lubricated needle, the glass or polymer barrel, the plunger stopper, etc.

blocks.zh: Syringe Subassembly (注射器次組件)：指已準備好可進行充填的注射器組件，通常由注射器筒身供應商提供，包含針頭護套、帶潤滑的針頭、筒身等。
blocks.en: Syringe Subassembly: The syringe assembly that is ready for filling, usually supplied by the syringe barrel supplier, including the needle shield, the lubricated needle, the barrel, etc.

blocks.zh: Plunger Stopper (柱塞膠塞)：包含膠塞本體及其表面處理（潤滑、塗層、覆膜），由膠塞供應商提供。
blocks.en: Plunger Stopper: The stopper body together with its surface treatment (lubrication, coating, film lamination), supplied by the stopper supplier.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把預充填注射器的 GSPR 文件想像成蓋房子的建築許可申請。申請者（Applicant）就像建商，負責整合所有文件向主管機關（NB）提出申請；注射器次組件供應商像是鋼筋水泥供應商，提供結構材料的檢驗報告；膠塞供應商像是門窗五金供應商，提供密封性能的測試數據。每個環節的文件都不可或缺，缺一環就無法取得使用執照。
blocks.en: Think of the GSPR documentation for a prefilled syringe as a building permit application. The Applicant is like the developer, who integrates all documents and submits the application to the authority (the NB); the syringe subassembly supplier is like the rebar and cement supplier, providing inspection reports for structural materials; and the stopper supplier is like the door, window and hardware supplier, providing test data on sealing performance. The documents from every link are indispensable: without one of them, the occupancy permit cannot be obtained.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 的三欄結構反映了產業實務中的責任分工：
blocks.en: The three-column structure of Table 5.1-1🔍 reflects the division of responsibilities in industry practice:

blocks.zh: 第1欄 (Device Part)：由「申請者」提供給公告機構（NB），是最終的合規證據
blocks.en: Column 1 (Device Part): Provided by the "Applicant" to the Notified Body (NB); this is the final compliance evidence

blocks.zh: 第2欄 (Syringe Subassembly)：由注射器「供應商」提供給申請者的支持性文件
blocks.en: Column 2 (Syringe Subassembly): Supportive documents provided by the syringe "Supplier" to the Applicant

blocks.zh: 第3欄 (Plunger Stoppers)：由膠塞「供應商」提供給申請者的支持性文件
blocks.en: Column 3 (Plunger Stoppers): Supportive documents provided by the stopper "Supplier" to the Applicant

blocks.zh: 注意：柱塞桿（plunger rod）、針頭護套剛性部分（rigid part of needle shield）及後擋（backstop）的文件列於 Section 5.3，不在本表範圍內。
blocks.en: Note: documents for the plunger rod, the rigid part of the needle shield and the backstop are listed in Section 5.3 and are not covered by this table.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Table 5.1-1🔍 要按「裝置零件/注射器次組件/膠塞」三欄來組織，而不是按 GSPR 條款分欄？
blocks.en: Why is Table 5.1-1🔍 organized by the three columns "Device Part / Syringe Subassembly / Stopper" rather than by GSPR clause?

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的法規專員，收到注射器供應商的文件包後，你需要做什麼整合工作才能滿足第1欄的要求？
blocks.en: If you are a regulatory specialist at a CDMO and have received a document package from the syringe supplier, what integration work do you need to do to meet the Column 1 requirements?

blocks.zh: Plunger rod 和 backstop 的文件為什麼不在 Table 5.1-1🔍 中？這反映了什麼樣的供應鏈結構？
blocks.en: Why are the documents for the plunger rod and backstop not in Table 5.1-1🔍? What kind of supply chain structure does this reflect?

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍: Supportive Documents Suggested to Address Relevant GSPRs Table 5.1-1🔍: 建議用於因應相關 GSPR 之支持性文件
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍: Supportive Documents Suggested to Address Relevant GSPRs (Table 5.1-1🔍)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — Table 5.1-1🔍 結構總覽
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Overview of the Structure of Table 5.1-1🔍

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 是整份 TR73-2 的核心參考表格，將 MDR Annex I 的 GSPR 條款對應到具體的文件需求。它分為兩大章節：
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 is the core reference table of the whole of TR73-2, mapping the GSPR clauses of MDR Annex I to specific documentation needs. It is divided into two main chapters:

blocks.zh: Chapter I — General Requirements (一般要求，GSPR 1–8)：涵蓋預期性能、風險管理、風險控制、特性與性能、設計/製造/包裝、風險與副作用等基本要求
blocks.en: Chapter I - General Requirements (GSPR 1-8): Covers basic requirements such as intended performance, risk management, risk control, characteristics and performance, design/manufacture/packaging, and risks and side effects

blocks.zh: Chapter II — Design and Manufacture (設計與製造要求，GSPR 10–11)：涵蓋化學/物理/生物特性、污染物與殘留物風險、物質與材料使用、CMR/ED 物質、鄰苯二甲酸酯、非預期物質進入風險、微粒風險、感染與微生物污染等
blocks.en: Chapter II - Design and Manufacture (GSPR 10-11): Covers chemical/physical/biological properties, risks from contaminants and residues, use of substances and materials, CMR/ED substances, phthalates, risk of unintended substances entering, particulate risk, infection and microbial contamination, etc.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Chapter I 常見文件模式
blocks.en: Key Notes - Common Document Patterns in Chapter I

blocks.zh: 觀察 GSPR 1–8 的 Device Part 欄位，會發現幾份核心文件反覆出現：
blocks.en: Looking at the Device Part column for GSPR 1-8, several core documents appear repeatedly:

blocks.zh: Risk Management File (風險管理檔案)：幾乎每個 GSPR 都需要，包含風險管理計畫、危害識別、使用相關風險分析、上市後監督計畫
blocks.en: Risk Management File: Needed for almost every GSPR; includes the risk management plan, hazard identification, use-related risk analysis and post-market surveillance plan

blocks.zh: Design Verification Summary Report (設計驗證摘要報告)：證明產品符合設計規格
blocks.en: Design Verification Summary Report: Demonstrates that the product meets the design specifications

blocks.zh: Usability Engineering File (可用性工程檔案)：證明使用者可安全且正確使用裝置（GSPR 1, 5, 8 需要）
blocks.en: Usability Engineering File: Demonstrates that users can use the device safely and correctly (required for GSPR 1, 5 and 8)

blocks.zh: Traceability Matrix (可追溯性矩陣)：將所有要求連結到對應的驗證活動
blocks.en: Traceability Matrix: Links all requirements to the corresponding verification activities

blocks.zh: GMP Compliance (GMP 合規)：因為預充填注射器是藥品與器材的組合，必須同時符合藥品 GMP
blocks.en: GMP Compliance: Because a prefilled syringe is a combination of drug and device, it must also comply with medicinal product GMP

blocks.zh: 供應商欄位的模式更為統一：通常要求提供高階風險管理摘要（high-level risk management summary）和 QMS 實施證據（ISO 13485 / ISO 15378）。
blocks.en: The pattern in the supplier columns is more uniform: they generally ask for a high-level risk management summary and evidence of QMS implementation (ISO 13485 / ISO 15378).

blocks.zh: 想像你在申請一棟大樓的使用執照：
blocks.en: Imagine you are applying for an occupancy permit for a large building:

blocks.zh: GSPR 1–3（預期性能與風險管理）就像建築設計審查 — 你需要提出完整的設計圖、結構分析報告和安全評估
blocks.en: GSPR 1-3 (intended performance and risk management) are like the architectural design review: you need to submit complete design drawings, structural analysis reports and safety assessments

blocks.zh: GSPR 4–5（風險控制）就像消防和防震審查 — 要展示具體的風險控制措施
blocks.en: GSPR 4-5 (risk control) are like the fire and seismic reviews: you must show specific risk control measures

blocks.zh: GSPR 6–7（特性與設計/製造/包裝）就像材料檢驗和施工品質管控 — 需要放行規格、架儲壽命資料、穩定性數據
blocks.en: GSPR 6-7 (characteristics, and design/manufacture/packaging) are like material inspection and construction quality control: release specifications, shelf life data and stability data are needed

blocks.zh: GSPR 8（風險與副作用）就像最終的綜合安全評估 — 效益/風險評估和殘餘風險揭露
blocks.en: GSPR 8 (risks and side effects) is like the final overall safety assessment: benefit/risk evaluation and disclosure of residual risks

blocks.zh: 而供應商提供的文件就像各個分包商（鋼筋廠、水泥廠）出具的材料證明書。
blocks.en: The documents provided by suppliers are like the material certificates issued by the individual subcontractors (the rebar plant, the cement plant).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Chapter II (GSPR 10.x) 深度要求
blocks.en: Key Notes - In-Depth Requirements of Chapter II (GSPR 10.x)

blocks.zh: Chapter II 的文件要求遠比 Chapter I 更為細緻，反映了材料科學和生物相容性的複雜性：
blocks.en: The documentation requirements of Chapter II are far more detailed than those of Chapter I, reflecting the complexity of materials science and biocompatibility:

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables (E&L，萃取物與浸出物)：GSPR 10.1(a)(b)(d)、10.2、10.3、10.4.1 都需要 E&L 評估，包含 ICH Q3D 元素雜質
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables (E&L): GSPR 10.1(a)(b)(d), 10.2, 10.3 and 10.4.1 all require an E&L assessment, including ICH Q3D elemental impurities

blocks.zh: Biocompatibility (生物相容性)：注射器次組件參照 ISO 10993-1，膠塞額外參照 USP <87>
blocks.en: Biocompatibility: The syringe subassembly refers to ISO 10993-1; the stopper additionally refers to USP <87>

blocks.zh: REACH / CMR / ED / Phthalates：GSPR 10.4.2 和 10.4.3 特別針對致癌/致突變/生殖毒性物質及內分泌干擾物質的申報
blocks.en: REACH / CMR / ED / Phthalates: GSPR 10.4.2 and 10.4.3 specifically address the declaration of carcinogenic/mutagenic/reproductive toxic substances and endocrine-disrupting substances

blocks.zh: Ph. Eur. (歐洲藥典)：注射器次組件需符合 Ph. Eur. 3.1.8, 3.2.1, 3.2.2.1 等，膠塞需符合 Ph. Eur. 3.1.8, 3.2.9
blocks.en: Ph. Eur. (European Pharmacopoeia): The syringe subassembly must comply with Ph. Eur. 3.1.8, 3.2.1, 3.2.2.1, etc.; the stopper must comply with Ph. Eur. 3.1.8 and 3.2.9

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity (CCI，容器密封完整性)：GSPR 10.5 特別要求 CCI 和穩定性測試，聚合物注射器還需要滲透性研究
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity (CCI): GSPR 10.5 specifically requires CCI and stability testing, and polymer syringes also need permeability studies

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — ISO 標準對照
blocks.en: Key Concepts - ISO Standards Cross-Reference

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 引用了大量 ISO 標準，理解它們的對應關係非常重要：
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 cites a large number of ISO standards, and it is important to understand how they relate to each other:

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-4, -6, -7：預充填注射器系列標準（玻璃筒身-4、聚合物筒身-6、不鏽鋼彈性護套組件-7）— 注射器次組件供應商的核心標準
blocks.en: ISO 11040-4, -6, -7: The prefilled syringe series (glass barrels -4, polymer barrels -6, stainless steel elastomeric shield assemblies -7); core standards for syringe subassembly suppliers

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-5：柱塞膠塞標準 — 膠塞供應商的核心標準
blocks.en: ISO 11040-5: The plunger stopper standard; the core standard for stopper suppliers

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-8：與藥品接觸的預充填注射器要求 — 申請者的整合標準
blocks.en: ISO 11040-8: Requirements for prefilled syringes in contact with the drug product; the integrating standard for the Applicant

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1, -2, -3, -4：彈性體密封件系列 — 膠塞材料的基礎標準
blocks.en: ISO 8871-1, -2, -3, -4: The elastomeric parts series; the foundation standards for stopper materials

blocks.zh: ISO 9626 / ISO 7864 / ISO 15510：針管/一次性針頭/不鏽鋼標準 — 針頭相關
blocks.en: ISO 9626 / ISO 7864 / ISO 15510: Needle tubing / sterile hypodermic needles for single use / stainless steel standards; needle-related

blocks.zh: ISO 14971：醫療器材風險管理 — 貫穿所有 GSPR
blocks.en: ISO 14971: Risk management for medical devices; runs through all GSPRs

blocks.zh: IEC 62366-1：可用性工程 — 與使用者安全相關的 GSPR
blocks.en: IEC 62366-1: Usability engineering; relevant to GSPRs concerning user safety

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — GSPR 11.1 感染風險的滅菌要求
blocks.en: Key Notes - Sterilization Requirements for the Infection Risk in GSPR 11.1

blocks.zh: GSPR 11.1 (a-d) 的滅菌驗證要求值得特別注意：
blocks.en: The sterilization validation requirements of GSPR 11.1 (a-d) deserve special attention:

blocks.zh: 注射器次組件：引用 ISO 11135（環氧乙烷滅菌）、ISO 11137（輻射滅菌）、ISO 14937（通用滅菌要求）
blocks.en: Syringe subassembly: Refers to ISO 11135 (ethylene oxide sterilization), ISO 11137 (radiation sterilization) and ISO 14937 (general requirements for sterilization)

blocks.zh: 膠塞：引用 ISO 17665（濕熱滅菌）、ISO 11135、ISO 11137、ISO 11607-1（最終滅菌包裝）
blocks.en: Stopper: Refers to ISO 17665 (moist heat sterilization), ISO 11135, ISO 11137 and ISO 11607-1 (packaging for terminally sterilized devices)

blocks.zh: 兩者都需要運輸驗證摘要和含滅菌確認的品質證書
blocks.en: Both need a transport validation summary and a quality certificate that includes sterilization confirmation

blocks.zh: 這反映了注射器次組件和膠塞通常採用不同的滅菌方法：注射器多用 EtO 或輻射，膠塞常用高壓蒸汽滅菌。
blocks.en: This reflects the fact that syringe subassemblies and stoppers usually use different sterilization methods: syringes mostly use EtO or radiation, while stoppers often use autoclave (steam) sterilization.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO 的法規事務專員，正在準備一個新的預充填注射器產品的 MDR 技術文件。你需要：
blocks.en: Suppose you are a regulatory affairs specialist at a CDMO preparing the MDR technical documentation for a new prefilled syringe product. You need to:

blocks.zh: 向注射器筒身供應商索取：E&L 評估摘要、ISO 10993-1 生物相容性報告、Ph. Eur. 合規證據、ISO 11040-4/-6 合規聲明、滅菌驗證摘要、品質證書
blocks.en: Request from the syringe barrel supplier: E&L assessment summary, ISO 10993-1 biocompatibility report, evidence of Ph. Eur. compliance, ISO 11040-4/-6 declaration of compliance, sterilization validation summary, quality certificate

blocks.zh: 向膠塞供應商索取：E&L 評估摘要（含 USP <87>）、ISO 8871 系列合規聲明、ISO 11040-5 合規聲明、Ph. Eur. 3.2.9 合規證據、CMR/ED/鄰苯二甲酸酯含量聲明
blocks.en: Request from the stopper supplier: E&L assessment summary (including USP <87>), ISO 8871 series declaration of compliance, ISO 11040-5 declaration of compliance, evidence of Ph. Eur. 3.2.9 compliance, declaration of CMR/ED/phthalate content

blocks.zh: 自行準備：風險管理檔案（ISO 14971）、設計驗證摘要報告（含生物評估報告）、可追溯性矩陣、可用性工程檔案（IEC 62366-1）、藥品 GMP 合規證據
blocks.en: Prepare yourself: Risk management file (ISO 14971), design verification summary report (including the biological evaluation report), traceability matrix, usability engineering file (IEC 62366-1), evidence of medicinal product GMP compliance

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 就是你的「文件檢核清單」，確保不遺漏任何法規要求的支持性文件。
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 is your "document checklist", ensuring that no supportive document required by the regulations is missed.

blocks.zh: 為什麼膠塞供應商在 GSPR 10.1(a) 需要額外提供 USP <87> 的生物相容性數據，而注射器次組件供應商只需 ISO 10993-1？
blocks.en: Why does the stopper supplier need to provide additional USP <87> biocompatibility data for GSPR 10.1(a), while the syringe subassembly supplier needs only ISO 10993-1?

blocks.zh: GSPR 10.4.2（CMR/ED 物質）對 Device Part 欄位標註「Not directly applicable」，但仍要求供應商提供含量聲明。這背後的法規邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: GSPR 10.4.2 (CMR/ED substances) is marked "Not directly applicable" in the Device Part column, yet suppliers are still asked for a content declaration. What is the regulatory logic behind this?

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品使用聚合物筒身（polymer barrel）而非玻璃筒身，在 GSPR 10.5 會多出什麼額外要求？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your product uses a polymer barrel rather than a glass barrel, what additional requirements arise under GSPR 10.5? Why?

blocks.zh: 比較 GSPR 10.2（污染物與殘留物）和 GSPR 10.4.1（物質或微粒風險）的文件要求，哪些文件是重疊的？哪些是 10.2 獨有的？
blocks.en: Compare the documentation requirements of GSPR 10.2 (contaminants and residues) and GSPR 10.4.1 (risks from substances or particles): which documents overlap, and which are unique to 10.2?

blocks.zh: 從表中找出所有提及 EMA/CHMP/CVMP/QWP/850374/2015 的 GSPR 條款。這份 EMA 指引主要涉及什麼議題？
blocks.en: From the table, find all GSPR clauses that mention EMA/CHMP/CVMP/QWP/850374/2015. What main topic does this EMA guideline address?
